The playground sends the Run settings drawer's tool switches as toolNames (a run-scoped narrowing of the agent's tools, nothing saved). The chat body is built inside streamChat's resumable wrapper (lib/api/chat.ts), whose request fields the extractor does not read, so the one field the console adds there is declared by hand.
